external_list_scope: Full cross-track lineage inventory; per-item role identifies actual use. Failed experimental backbones are not claimed as deployed components.
inference: Static 1024-square RGB input; raw segmentation with the inherited normalizer; shared whole-image 384x512 branch evaluated twice with horizontal flip/unflip/mean. No tiles or OTHER55 blend. StatisticalRestorerV3S v5, separable USM k=0.8, two RGB guided filters r=16 then 4, epsilon=0.001, post-USM guide.
teacher_definition: Track1v1 foreground scores to log-odds, background threshold, minimum winner lift for selective-fusion priority rules, per-source/path TRAIN temperature calibration; no CascadePSP hard-target mixing.
training_only_projector: v100: 96-to-256 channel 1x1 projector, cosine loss weight 0.5; excluded from export
training_metadata: Filename water/depth used for teacher E034 and TRAIN synthesis only; ONNX input is RGB only.

restorer_record.name: StatisticalRestorerV3S v5
restorer_record.note: Actual supplied v5 file; not the proposed v5b10epoch architecture. Same checkpoint and output as the uploaded T1/T1v100 artifacts.
